bullets.text: Satellite Services Approved - **Ofcom** greenlights direct-to-device satellite services for UK smartphones, enhancing connectivity in remote areas.
BT's Sovereign Platform - **BT** launches a sovereign platform for UK enterprises, ensuring data control amid geopolitical uncertainties.
Generative AI Potential - **Frost & Sullivan** highlights the transformative impact of generative AI on telecom operations and customer experience.
Value-Added Services Growth - **Incognito** emphasizes the importance of value-added services for ISPs to enhance customer retention.
AI-Driven Cyber Defense - **NTT DATA** announces new AI-powered cyber defense centers to bolster security against evolving threats.
Vodafone's Testing Automation - **Vodafone** partners with **Spirent** to automate software testing for faster 5G voice service rollouts.
Cloudflare Outage Insights - Recent **Cloudflare** outage underscores the risks of relying on concentrated infrastructure for enterprise services.
AI-RAN Transformation - **Indosat** shifts to an AI-native network strategy, enhancing efficiency and service delivery across Indonesia.
World Communication Awards - Celebrating innovation, the **2025 World Communication Awards** recognize excellence across the telecom industry.
